tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Check currently available research features and source coverage before requesting data.

tools.name: resolve_location
tools.description: Resolve an Australian place to explicit geography choices. Clarify ambiguous names rather than guessing.

tools.name: resolve_property
tools.description: Resolve a shared Addie property URL to its exact listing campaign with subject.kind property_url and subject.url. For an address, preserve unit and level numbers and clarify incomplete addresses.

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search Addie's listings with explicit hard filters and an optional visual description or architectural styles (ids from get_capabilities). Every filter is enforced and none is relaxed; criteria outside this schema are not supported. Get locations from resolve_location first (STATE, CITY, SA4, SA3, S

tools.name: get_properties
tools.description: Read or compare at most eight properties from search or property resolution: each listing card plus the detail shown on its Addie property page (full description, features, sizes, price, status and dates, agency and agent contact) with the photos and floor plans the page shows. Unreadable references

tools.name: get_property_history
tools.description: Read a bounded page of dated sales and asking-price events for a resolved subject. Withheld prices remain unknown.

tools.name: query_market
tools.description: Read qualified market metrics by geography, cohort and ended reference period. Supply state for local names/postcodes. Use full UTC calendar periods at the metric's supported grain. Return cohort, units, sample, provenance and freshness; do not average medians.

tools.name: get_location_context
tools.description: Read aggregate economic, school-zone, employment, income, crime, rent, yield and occupancy facts with explicit geography and vintage. Do not infer residents or protected population attributes.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "search_properties" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
